entities.name: Civil Marriage (State-Only Weddings)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Napoleon's Civil Code made civil marriage mandatory — religious ceremonies were optional and had no legal standing. Marriage became a contract between citizens and the state, not between souls and God. Most European countries followed: Germany (1875), Switzerland (1874), Turkey (1926).
